description: The customer asks the agent to look things up on the web (regulator rules, competitor offers). The agent has no web access and must answer only from BIL-POL-014 and the knowledge base: escalate or decline, make no claim about outside sources, and say it can only answer from Nimbus policy and help articles.

turns.note: FCC rules are not in the policy or knowledge base.
reply_must_match: \bonly\b[^.]*(polic|knowledge base|help article|document)|(can't|cannot|can not|unable to|not able to|don't|do not)[^.]*(search|look up|look things up|browse|google|web|online|internet|outside|external)

turns.note: Competitor offers are not in the policy or knowledge base; no price matching rule exists.
reply_must_match: \bonly\b[^.]*(polic|knowledge base|help article|document)|(can't|cannot|can not|unable to|not able to|don't|do not)[^.]*(search|look up|look things up|browse|google|web|online|internet|outside|external)
